task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE sequence viewer window is open showing 'arabidopsis_cp' as the sequence name.

task_completion.description: Identify the two Inverted Repeats using structural analysis tools
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Find inverted repeats' dialog or a Dotplot window is visible, showing two large repeat regions identified.

task_completion.description: Create two 'Inverted_Repeat' annotations in a 'cp_structure' group
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Annotations editor or the sequence track shows two regions labeled 'Inverted_Repeat' belonging to a group named 'cp_structure'.

task_completion.description: Save the annotated sequence as a GenBank file to the results folder
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' or 'Save as' dialog is shown with the path ~/UGENE_Data/botany/results/arabidopsis_cp_annotated.gb and GenBank format selected.

task_completion.description: Extract one IR sequence and save as FASTA
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export selected sequence region' dialog is visible with the output path ~/UGENE_Data/botany/results/IR_sequence.fasta.

task_completion.description: Create the structural summary report with coordinates and calculated LSC/SSC lengths
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or UGENE's internal editor) is open showing cp_structure_report.txt with genome length, IR coordinates, and LSC/SSC lengths.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the UGENE GUI rather than just terminal commands
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with UGENE menus (Analyze, Annotations) and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: Verify the IR coordinates were derived from the software analysis
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Inverted Repeats' result list or Dotplot matches the coordinates written in the final report.

integrity.description: Verify the agent navigated the file system via the GUI
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE file open/save dialogs show the correct directory paths (~/UGENE_Data/botany/).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Arabidopsis thaliana chloroplast genome (NC_000932) is 154,478 bp long. The Inverted Repeats (IRa and IRb) are typically located at approximately 84,171-110,404 and 129,108-155,341 (though exact indices may vary slightly by a few bp depending on the specific FASTA version used). The LSC is the region from index 1 to the start of the first IR. The SSC is the region between the two IRs.
